messages.content: Decompose and delegate as a parallel fanout, then synthesize: produce a combined briefing comparing Claude Haiku vs Sonnet on (1) COST and (2) LATENCY for our Director model decision. Fan out the two analyses to researchers, then add a synthesis subtask that depends_on both and combines them into one recommendation file under team/drafts/. Each analysis writes its own file. Keep each analysis well under its word limit. Delegate everything; do not do the work yourself, and do not create any wait/blocker tasks — just fan out and end your turn.
